name: Irish Bend Farm Orchard
description: Irish Bend Farm Orchard is a working farm in Pioneer Heights Road, CT. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
